checks.detail: Q105 protocol constants and canonical archive blob SHA match preregistration.
3403 unique chronological rows; each outcome is a sorted five-number subset of 1..40.
3203/3203 forecasts use only rows with index less than the target; previous-day cutoff verified.
Weekday counts use only prior rows matching the target weekday; target row is added after scoring.
e5 dynamic program agrees with brute-force enumeration on an eight-weight synthetic fixture.
Representative global and weekday normalizers match exhaustive enumeration of all 658008 subsets; max relative error 2.047e-13.
9/9 fixed-cutoff forecasts unchanged after mutating all later outcomes.
All global and weekday models have finite positive weights and normalizers.
Block length, sign-flip replicates, bootstrap replicates and seed match the preregistered protocol exactly.
Exactly two preregistered Blind OOS endpoints receive Holm correction; weekday subgroup summaries are descriptive only.
